en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view from a forested hillside looking down onto a Central European town in a broad agricultural valley. Conifer trees frame the foreground. In the middle distance there is a dense cluster of traditional multi‑story buildings with steep roofs and at least one tall church spire. Smokestacks or factory chimneys rise on the valley floor, and beyond the town are patterned fields and low rolling hills. The margins of the image are rough, suggesting an old photographic print reproduced as a postcard. There is very faint, nearly unreadable mirrored handwriting or printing along the upper edge of the image.
